name: Formalization Is Analyzed
description: Every formalized model is either verified or analyzed — no model is built and left unused.
rationale: A formalization that is never verified or decomposed is dead weight — building a model only pays off when the model is actually reasoned over, so an unused Formalize is a flagged gap.

examples.passes: Formalize(model) → Verify(model) (or StateSpaceAnalysis(model)) later in the trace
examples.fails: Formalize(model) with no subsequent Verify or StateSpaceAnalysis
